content:
**Dead Man Sprinting** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Sprint faster at increased AP cost with decreased health.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Sprint 20% faster at increased AP cost when your health is below 50%. | 003896F4 | 
| ★ | 1 | Sprint 10% faster at increased AP cost when your health is below 40%. | 003896EE |
